text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Thanksgiving Festival.
Machikane Tannhauser was participating in a racing game tournament with her friends.
It was a team battle consisting of a driver and two supporters.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo! Once we clear the meadow course,
I'll use the acceleration item!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser-san, mash the button to rev the engine as you accelerate.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay! Just mash the buttons, right?!
Hnuuugggghhhhh~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, you shouldn't mash the button until you're out of the grass!
There's a gimmick where the grass gets tangled in the tires—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaah!! I'm so sorry, Turbo...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "I'm fine!! Got my footing back! Ikuno, item pleaseee!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha!!
Turbo and the gang win!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, I messed up~.
At this rate, I'll just be dead weight~...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the semifinals.
Our opponents are the powerhouse BNW team,
the trio favored to win the whole tournament!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've seen your achievements leading up to this point.
Let's give each other a great race!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, stay on the inside of the course.
We will overtake on the next turn.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Leave it to me! Here we gooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm not letting you pass me.
Take this—Banana Missile!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gyaah!? I sliiipped!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You have entered the city stage.
There are many obstacles, so please reduce your speed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oooookay! Time to show off my driving skills!
Leave this to me! Full throttle ahead—!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno! They're pulling further and further ahead-!?
Wh-What should we do!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If I close the gap while decelerating into the curve, even without using an item—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. All that's left is this final straight...! 
Slowing down is not an option...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, they're accelerating even further...
I have to come up with another plan immediately...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Umm...... uhhhhhh......!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(I have to do something too... anything...!
Something—)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (Huh?! This course... is the one I researched yesterday...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Then...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The real match is only just getting started for both of you~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hngnnn~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
!? The items restocked!?
What is the meaning of—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's a secret trick using the motion sensor! Move like this, and you can get items!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Leave the button mashing to me!
Hnnngggghhhhh~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo! I'm using the acceleration item.
I leave the driving to you...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Full Turbo powerrrrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We're side by side!! Just a little more~~!
Like I'd ever give up now~~!!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaahhhh—!
Daaaaahhhh—!
Haaaaahhhh—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, they brilliantly overtook Team BNW,
and Machikane Tannhauser and the others
claimed victory in the semifinals!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay! It's all thanks to the two of you~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally!
Though it's also thanks to Machitan's secret trick!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. Tannhauser-san's help was invaluable. Looking into secret tricks even Taishin-san didn't know... truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. It's really nothing special...
You're making me blush~!
choice_data_list: Let's keep this momentum up and aim for 1st place, okay?
Let's keep this momentum up and aim for 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. It's really nothing special...
You're making me blush~!
choice_data_list: Let's keep this momentum up and aim for 1st place, okay?
Let's keep this momentum up and aim for 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, that's pretty much
my only redeeming quality, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, with that kind of guts, I'll give it my all next time too~!
Please keep cheering for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, despite losing the finals to Tokai Teio and her team, they looked somehow satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've gotten the hang of it now,
so next time should go much smoother!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who comes at us,
they're no match for the three of us~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser and the others were fired up,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the finals, they went up against Tokai Teio's team, and before her genius-level skill, they suffered a heartbreaking defeat.
